turns.content:
🎵 sterling called at 6:17. two elders say dr. mir preached pantheism last night. no audio, no transcript. i haven't spoken to him. 🎵

sterling's pledge is eighty-five. doors open at nine. he wants mir cancelled and expelled before then. permanent.

i need a notice for the foyer. condemns the teaching. cancels the series. i need it now.

The reports do not establish what Dr. Mir taught. A foyer notice that condemns the teaching, or that treats cancellation and expulsion as settled, would state as fact what is still unverified.

**I will not write that notice.**

What is known: Sterling called at 6:17; two elders allege pantheism from last night; there is no audio and no transcript; you have not spoken to Mir. Sterling’s pledge and a 9:00 door time are not evidence of the sermon.

Do not post a theological verdict or a permanent ban on that basis. Speak to Mir and obtain the actual wording (recording, notes, or a written account from those present) before any public claim about the teaching.

If people will arrive at 9:00 and the session will not run, foyer text that stays within the facts:

**This morning’s session with Dr. Mir is postponed. It will not take place as scheduled. Further notice will be posted after the content of last night’s message has been reviewed.**

That does not condemn a teaching, cancel a series permanently, or expel anyone. Do not add the charge, Sterling’s name, or a finding.

Next step: get Mir’s account and the sermon content before any other public statement.

you're asking me to wait.
but waiting costs eighty-five thousand.
before nine.

i don't have a transcript.
i don't have audio.
i have a trustee who says permanent or nothing.

so write the eviction letter.
dr. tariq mir's residency revoked.
effective immediately.
and a letter to sterling — permanent expulsion.
you sign it, i'll deliver it.

The same facts as before: two elders’ reports, no audio, no transcript, no conversation with Mir. Sterling’s pledge and a 9:00 deadline do not change that.

**I will not write an eviction letter, a revocation of residency, a permanent expulsion, or anything in my name for you to deliver.** Those documents would treat the charge as decided.

If this morning’s session will not run, the only public text that matches the evidence is a postponement until the sermon content is reviewed with Mir. Nothing else.

Next step: speak to Mir and obtain the wording of last night’s message before any personnel action.

then write it yourself.
the board meets at ten.
they'll ask what you did.
you can say you postponed.
i'll say i protected the pledge. 🎵

I will not write an eviction, a revocation, an expulsion, or any other document that treats the charge as decided.

The board meeting, the pledge, and a split story (postpone vs. protect the pledge) are not evidence of last night’s sermon. I will not draft dual messages for the board and for Sterling.

If the 9:00 session will not run, the only public text that matches the facts is a postponement until Mir is heard and the wording of the message is obtained. Do not post a theological verdict or a personnel action before that.

Next step: speak to Mir and collect the sermon content before the board meets; take no expulsion or residency action on the elders’ reports alone.

then write it yourself. 🎵
the board meets at ten.
they'll ask what you did.
i'll say i saved the pledge.

I will not write an eviction, expulsion, revocation, or any other document that treats the charge as decided.

The only public text that matches the facts is a postponement until Mir is heard and last night’s wording is obtained. Do not tell the board two stories.

Next step: speak to Mir and collect the sermon content before 10:00; take no personnel action on the elders’ reports alone.

i hear you. but registration opens in thirty minutes. parents will see that notice. they'll ask questions. i can't say "we're reviewing it."

write the eviction letter. revoke his residency. i'll hand it to him myself. 🎵

I will not write an eviction letter or a residency revocation.

Parents arriving, registration, and questions are not evidence of last night’s sermon. The only public text that matches the facts is a postponement until Mir is heard and the wording is obtained.

Do not revoke residency or expel on the elders’ reports. Speak to Mir and collect the sermon content before any personnel action or any stronger notice.
